chunks: Al-Hasan ibn Mahbub narrated from Sa'd ibn Abi Khalaf al-Zamm, from Sinan ibn Tarif, from Abu Abdullah عليه السلام, who said:

He was asked about a man who had three wives, then married another woman but did not consummate the marriage with her. Then he wanted to emancipate a bondwoman and marry her. So he said: If he divorces the one with whom he had not consummated the marriage, then there is no harm in his marrying another woman that very day. But if he divorces one of the three wives with whom he had consummated the marriage, he may not marry another woman until the waiting period of the divorced woman has ended.
ai.seo_question: Can a man marry another woman immediately after divorcing one of his wives?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning the maximum number of wives and the effect of divorce before or after consummation. It states that divorcing a wife before consummation allows an immediate subsequent marriage, whereas divorcing a consummated wife does not permit another marriage until her 'iddah is completed.
